profile.headline: Software Engineer at Standard Metrics
profile.summary: JavaScript, React, Python, SQL, MongoDB, Express, Node, HTML, CSS, Flutter, Arduino, MQL4, PHP, Salesforce, Linux, AWS, Digital Ocean, NGINX, Cisco CCENT

positions.title: Adjunct Instructor
positions.description: Part-Time Instructor for FSW-115 (API's), FSW-123 (React) and AFS-200 (Python) courses in the Web Development career track. Time is spent equally between lecturing, grading, and 1:1 tutoring to ensure students are prepared for graduation.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
Leading the effort to modernize our stack and migrate existing PHP/WordPress code base into a React/Node infrastructure.

Role includes back-end engineering and many 3rd party integrations - including Salesforce, Google & AWS, as well as front-end web development. 

Responsible for maintaining and adhering to SOLID design principles, writing scaleable architecture patterns, full-stack software security, achieving component reusability within the React framework, and road mapping agile development rollouts.

positions.title: MERN Instructor/TA
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
Answering technical questions and teaching lessons covering the MERN stack. 

Responsible for ensuring bootcamp students have a solid foundation and in depth understanding of coding principles.

positions.title: Tractor Trailer Operator
positions.description:
Personally responsible for effecting on-time delivery of all manner of commodities throughout the United States and Canada. 

Polite and professional communication with customers. 

Ability to manage my time effectively to meet crucial deadlines.

Required to be flexible and work within the operating parameters of hundreds of different businesses.

Holding ultimate personal accountability for decisions regarding the safety of myself and the motoring public.

positions.title: Client Solutions Manager
positions.description:
Helping businesses leaders take advantage of technology trends influencing the marketplace, my role includes:

-  Understanding wants and needs
-  Provide solutions that meet and exceed those wants/needs
-  Develop and sustain mutually beneficial client relationships
-  Manage resources and inspire collaboration
-  Compress the time it takes to build trust
-  Set and facilitate expectations
-  Gain access to different functional areas and decision makers
-  Uncover and position solutions that help my customers reach their top objectives
-  Build profitable sales for my organization through activity with results
-  Run my realm of responsibility as a business

positions.title: Account Manager
positions.description:
Consult with small to mid-size businesses for the Google Offers program as well as many other business marketing & promotional programs.

Focused on building long-term relationships with business owners and enhancing their profitability with cutting edge technologies.

Identifying, implementing, and troubleshooting comprehensive image-based backup/recovery solutions with resellers, end users, and MSP's. 

Heavy emphasis on virtualization, cloud, big data, BYOD, MDM, and MFM integration.

positions.title: International Account Manager
positions.description:
Develop new prospects into end-users, distributors, and resellers in APAC and EMEA. 

Assisted in laying the groundwork and building the VAR and distribution channel in over a dozen countries. 

Conduct remote technical product demonstrations and training on WAN optimization and line aggregation hardware - crucial for enhancing developing countries IT infrastructure.

projects.title: SmartGarden
projects.description: This is a MERN full stack app. It makes axios requests to a MongoDB which allows adding, removing and saving plants or gardens. It also provides custom plant recommendations based on companion planting.

projects.title: Blackjack for Card Counters
projects.description: This is a front end React application that is not your average Blackjack game. It is designed to teach players how to count cards and maintains comprehensive game analytics. It uses the Deck of Cards API to provide deck, card, and shuffle functionality.
